freshSignupLiveEndpoint.reason: Live server still ran the pre-fix signup code and returned the workspace foreign-key error. Fix is committed but live deployment was not available in this environment.

dashboardRoleAudit.details: Admin Team & Users page exposed seat usage, optional phone input, role assignment, permission matrix, lock/reset/remove actions, and the mobile/desktop device table. No destructive action or plan change was performed.

dashboardControlAudit.details: Live Admin dashboard shortcuts opened Dashboard Overview, CRM Kanban, Lead Import, Contacts, Calls, and Team & Users. CRM side drawer preserved lead context; filters, stage controls, notes/follow-up actions, call history, and recording-status states were visible. Calls campaign delete actions now have explicit accessible labels.

adminMenuAudit.details: Live Admin navigation was opened item by item. Dashboard, CRM, Contacts, Lead Import, Calls & Power Dialer, Chat, Lead Form Builder, Plugins, WhatsApp Marketing, AI Bot, Developer, Reports, and Team & Users resolved to distinct surfaces. Grab Leads showed a closer-oriented round-robin claim queue with no available leads and was not useful for Admin; Settings, Team & Channels resolved to the Team & Users surface and was blocked by the sidebar footer overlap in the current deployment. Local fix now hides Grab Leads for workspace Admins and reserves a third sidebar grid row so Settings remains accessible; no live campaign, call, or data mutation was triggered during the audit.

callsPowerDialerAudit.details: Admin Calls & Power Dialer opened successfully and exposed the single-page hub for outbound campaigns, sequential dialing, missed-call/IVR recovery, SIM call history, and recording playback. New Calling Campaign opens a clear setup form (name, objective, daily target, cooldown); the form was opened and cancelled without creating a campaign. Existing QA call history rendered owner, duration, disposition, notes, playback speed controls, and seek controls. Several QA recordings correctly surfaced Recording unavailable because native emulator audio was not captured; the synthetic WAV path remains separately verified.

adminReportingView.details: Admin dashboard now acts as a management/reporting view: the admin profile and all admin-owned leads/calls are excluded from summary metrics, the user selector contains only active sales/manager users, and a Team performance & ownership table shows per-user active leads, calls, connected calls, callbacks, and ready recordings. The personal closer target tracker is not shown to Admin. Local runtime evidence: 4 sales users, 343 team leads, 10 team calls, and 4 user rows; Admin profiles were not counted.

seatCapacityCreationUx.details: When all plan seats are active, the Team & Users screen explains the limit on first render, keeps the optional phone field available, and disables account creation with an accessible upgrade action instead of allowing a confusing no-op click.

recordingStatusLabels.details: CRM drawer, CRM list, call history, and Android Calls & Recordings now share user-facing labels: Ready to play, Processing, Recording unavailable, and No recording. Raw FAILED/RECORDING_UNAVAILABLE states are no longer shown as the primary label.

bulkCampaignSelectionGuard.details: Contacts & Import Hub no longer renders a clickable Bulk Campaign action when no contacts are selected. After selecting one contact, the action appears with the exact selected count and passes only those IDs to the campaign flow.

roleScopedDashboardUi.details: Local rendered sessions confirmed Admin sees the full workspace surface, Manager sees team/contacts/import controls and team data, and Closer sees only Dashboard, CRM, Grab Leads, and Chat with 36 scoped leads. A Closer direct Contacts URL did not expose the admin contacts hub; the CRM drawer showed no delete control and retained previous-handler context.

contactsDirectoryLoad.details: The local Contacts directory first showed its explicit temporary-unavailable state during the slow initial response, then the visible Retry contacts action loaded all 718 contacts. No silent empty directory was shown; the initial response latency remains a performance follow-up.

disabledLeadActionGuidance.details: Disabled Add note, Save follow-up, and timeline Add controls now expose clear accessible labels and titles explaining the required note text or follow-up date.

effectivePermissionRefresh.details: Open dashboards now refresh role permissions on focus and every 30 seconds, and the refresh API resolves the configured workspace role before selecting the permission matrix. Manager team visibility follows that same effective role.

contactsDirectoryLive.details: Live Contacts directory eventually loaded the three QA contacts after approximately 5–6 seconds. A read-only live CSV preview using an existing CRM phone exposed that the currently deployed build reported Duplicates 0 / Import 1; the preview was discarded without saving. Local fix b475d05 now performs tenant-scoped phone/email duplicate detection before preview and save, and clears the stale preview banner on discard; deployment is required to verify the fix live.

createCloser.reason: Fresh workspace is Free 1/1 seats; no additional seat was available. No billing or plan mutation was performed.

roundRobin.reason: Requires multiple active sales users; blocked by the 1/1 seat limit.

mobileLogin.details: Fresh APK login reproduced the active-session conflict and displayed the Login here takeover action. Setup remained correctly blocked by existing device ownership; it did not silently reassign the company phone. A stale-session recovery fix was committed in 4ee160d. A setup fail-closed fix was committed in 3bfe01a: denied permissions, call-screening role, or overlay access no longer register the device and show a corrective message. A successful registration on a previously unregistered closer device was not completed because the workspace had no spare closer seat/device assignment. An additional mobile refresh fix in b010639 now sends expired-session responses from Inbox, learning, chat, customer-360, and lesson refreshes back to Login instead of leaving the user on a generic error screen; the rebuilt APK launched to Login after the stored session was cleared. The foreground lifecycle now also refreshes bootstrap permissions, lead/call data, and recording state when the app returns from background.

mobileLoginBranding.details: Rebuilt emulator APK no longer uses the dark-background banner raster that made the wordmark look clipped and duplicated. Login now renders the official orange AI mark with a readable Closer wordmark, a clear Welcome back heading, user-facing copy, and no overlapping branding. UI hierarchy was verified from the Android accessibility tree and a fresh emulator screenshot.

liveAdminMobileBootstrap.details: The live mobile login accepted the verified Admin account without exposing the token in evidence; the authenticated bootstrap returned HTTP 200 with Admin role, 723 leads, 5 calls, and permissions.

test2CredentialCheck.details: The supplied test2 account/password was rejected by both live mobile login (401 InvalidCredentials) and live web login redirect. This is an account/credential state issue, not a mobile-only authentication mismatch; no password reset or account mutation was performed.

webCrmSync.details: Live Kanban showed both QA leads, correct phone numbers, source labels, Contacted stage, notes, callbacks, latest call duration/outcome, and Previously handled by QA E2E Admin 20261008.

webCallHistory.details: Both calls appeared in the live SIM call history with duration, outcome, owner, notes, and explicit recording-unavailable error. Playback/speed controls were not passable because the emulator had no connected audio endpoint and no real recording was uploaded.

recordingPipelineSynthetic.details: A valid 1-second WAV was uploaded through the authenticated mobile recording endpoint for QA call cmuzp8it40004ygf4d0oivzqj on lead cmuz6k9it0009ksf4j8qlptyp. The call reached UPLOADED, the full recording returned 200/audio-wav with 16044 bytes, and a bytes=0-63 request returned 206 with Content-Range bytes 0-63/16044. The local web dashboard player verified play/pause, 1x/1.5x/2x/3x selection, and forward/backward seeking. This validates the server and web playback path; it does not replace native emulator microphone capture.

instagramCallbacks.details: Instagram deauthorize and data-deletion callback routes now verify Meta signed_request HMAC-SHA256 signatures, require a matching configured app ID when supplied, resolve only the matching Instagram business account, clear the token and disable the tenant connection, and reject unknown accounts without mutating state. Data deletion returns a confirmation URL and code.

recordingTenantIsolation.details: Privileged Admin/Manager recording reads now require the authenticated user's tenantId, while Closer reads remain limited to the caller's own agent or delegated child assignments. A regression contract prevents the recording route from reverting to callId-only lookup.

recordingVoiceNoteFallbackIsolation.details: The recording upload voice-note fallback now resolves assignments by both tenantId and assignedAgentId, preventing a foreign assignment ID from being linked to the current closer's recording.

nativeIncomingUi.details: The emulator GSM trigger produced the Android native incoming-call card for the test number 9800001702. The separate AI Closer Truecaller-style detail overlay was not verified in this run.

deleteAndCleanup.reason: QA records were retained for review; admin cleanup and closer deletion require an explicit cleanup pass after live deployment and seat setup.

commits.recordingPipelineVerification: local synthetic WAV upload + web playback verification

secrets: No passwords, access tokens, or session tokens are included.
